movement_leads_rising_total_dog.classification_evidence: Week-blocked P+ 0.0 (0 of 20,000 resamples positive) but the interval's upper bound sits AT exactly 0.0, not strictly below it -- a discrete-mass artifact of only 6 flagged games out of 456 (many bootstrap resamples draw none of the 6 flagged-game weeks and score an exact 0.0 delta), NOT a smoothly resolved negative interval. movement_leads_rising_total_dog.description: LEAD-06: games where the total rose >=2.0 pts from the Tuesday open to the latest pre-16:00-ET-Sunday-deadline snapshot while the spread moved <0.5, candidate takes the underdog at the frozen Tuesday line, production pick elsewhere. Assigned rotation window [2020,2021].
movement_leads_rising_total_dog.notes: docs/movement_leads_battery.md, cell 5 of 5. Only 6 games flagged in the entire [2020,2021] window (5 in 2020, 1 in 2021) -- an extremely small subgroup, so this reading is dominated by a handful of games and should not be read as a stable estimate in either direction. Latest pre-deadline checkpoint priority: tue_open < thu_pre_tnf < sat_midday < sun_early_close (sun_late_close/mon_pre_mnf excluded as post-16:00-ET-deadline). movement_leads_rising_total_dog.plain_summary: In the small number of games (6, out of 456) where the total climbed at least 2 points while the spread barely budged, betting the underdog did WORSE than the model's usual pick -- but with only 6 such games this is far too few to trust either way.

movement_leads_sun_vs_wed_per_point.description: LEAD-07 primary cell: paired difference in per-point value (accuracy points earned per point of observed line movement, among each day-part's own >=1.0pt-eligible games) between the Saturday-to-Sunday-morning day-part and the Tuesday-to-Wednesday day-part, on the joint 2023-2025 population with all four checkpoints resolvable. Predeclared direction: positive (Sunday-morning moves carry more per-point value than Wednesday moves).
movement_leads_sun_vs_wed_per_point.notes: docs/movement_leads_battery.md, cell 4 of 5, PRIMARY cell for the movement_leads_v1 rotation family record. UNIT CAVEAT, load-bearing: effect and interval are PER-POINT-OF-MOVEMENT RATES (accuracy points earned per point of observed line movement, i.e. paired_delta / mean(|move|) among each arm's own >=1.0pt-eligible subset), NOT a flat accuracy_points delta like every other accuracy_points entry in this registry. Do NOT pool this entry with plain accuracy_points deltas without rescaling; it is commensurable only with other explicitly per-point-value cells. n_wed_eligible=94, n_sun_am_eligible=72 (joint population 750, 2023-2025; NOT the assigned [2020,2021] rotation window -- no Wednesday checkpoint exists there, disclosed in the predeclaration doc). Positive control (perfect foresight) on the same joint population: +46.93 pts, P+ 1.0, proving harness sensitivity.
movement_leads_sun_vs_wed_per_point.plain_summary: Comparing the two ends of the week, a point of Sunday-morning line movement was worth more accuracy than a point of Tuesday-to-Wednesday movement -- consistent with the idea that later-week news (injuries, weather) carries more signal than early-week market flow -- and that direction held in about 93% of resamples, though the gap is still too small to call settled.
